home_section2.paragraph_1: Our company, based in Miami, specializes in custom carpentry manufacturing, both locally and imported from Europe. We offer tailored solutions that combine quality, design, and functionality, adapted to the needs of architects, designers, builders, and the general public. Additionally, we provide carpentry accessories and specialized technical support in drawing and rendering, ensuring the efficient management of each project.
home_section2.paragraph_2: To become the leading company in carpentry solutions, recognized for the excellence of our products and services. We aim to be the trusted partner of architects, designers, and builders, offering innovation, quality, and efficiency, both with our local carpentry in Miami and our European line.

home_section2.paragraph_32: Offer a comprehensive service that includes technical advice, design, and renderings, optimizing project management.
home_section2.paragraph_33: Maintain a constant commitment to innovation and sustainability in all our products and processes.
home_section2.paragraph_34: Provide creative and functional solutions that contribute to the success of each project.

home_section4.title: Our Process
home_section4.description: At Archiwood, every project starts with a unique idea and a fully personalized approach. Our process is designed to ensure that each piece of carpentry is a masterpiece that reflects your needs and vision. Here are the steps of our process:

options.title: Initial Consultation
options.description: We start with a meeting to understand your vision, needs, and the style you want to achieve. During this stage, we gather all the key details of the project to ensure that our solutions perfectly match your expectations.

options.title: Estimate and Budget
options.description: Based on the initial consultation, we provide a detailed estimate and a personalized budget. We ensure that the budget is transparent, clear, and adjusted to your needs, considering materials, manufacturing time, and installation.

options.title: Custom Design
options.description: Our design team creates custom plans and designs based on your requirements. We use advanced drawing and rendering tools so you can visualize the final design and make any adjustments before proceeding with production.

options.title: Material Selection
options.description: We work with you to choose the most suitable materials for your project, whether with high-quality local wood or our exclusive imported line from Europe. We ensure that the selected materials meet your aesthetic and durability expectations.

options.title: Manufacturing
options.description: Once the design and materials are approved, we begin manufacturing. Our team of expert carpenters brings each piece to life with precision, taking care of every detail to ensure the highest quality and finish.

options.title: Installation
options.description: The final step is installation. Our team handles delivery and installation on-site, ensuring that everything fits perfectly and meets the highest quality standards.

options.title: Post-Sales Support
options.description: After installation, we remain committed to your satisfaction. We offer post-sales support to address any concerns or additional needs.

home_section5.title: At Archiwood,
home_section5.paragraph: we take pride in offering custom carpentry solutions that not only meet but exceed our clients' expectations, creating extraordinary spaces with every project.

items.title: Discover our exclusive space
items.description_1: At Archiwood, we offer a unique experience in our showroom, located in Miami, where you can explore our custom carpentry solutions, both locally made and imported from Europe.
items.description_2: Here, you'll discover how quality, design, and functionality come together to offer you the best products and services. Whether you are an architect, designer, or homeowner, you'll find everything you need for your next project.

items.title: Expert advice at your disposal
items.description_1: We have a team of designers and technical experts ready to offer you personalized guidance, supporting you at every step of the process. From design to material selection and project management, we ensure you get the best solution for your space with the efficiency and quality that define us.
